label: board
about: The Tasks board (the `board` component of oxplow-bundled's `tasks` page): `scope` is `thread`, `stream`, `me`, `pool` or `all` — the work assigned to the viewed thread, its stream's threads, the person, nobody, or anyone (`v_task.assignee`); `thread_id` the viewed thread, which applies when `scope` is `thread`; a page's `stream_id` (implicit, as on every page) is the viewed stream, which applies when `scope` is `stream`. A view of the capability as a whole, so any extension may bring one: it reads `v_task` and runs the interface verbs (`oxplow.task.transition`, `update`, `assign`, `reorder`, …), whichever list is active. It shares the page's filters (`show`, `priority`, `q`, the tab's view): it draws them, as oxplow's board does, since the page has no rail.

label: list
about: The Task List's list (the `list` node of oxplow-bundled's `task-list` page): `scope` is `thread`, `stream`, `me`, `pool` or `all` — whom the items are assigned to (`v_task.assignee`); `thread_id` the viewed thread, which applies when `scope` is `thread`. The page's filters and New Task… stay oxplow's.

label: description editor
about: A task's description editor (the `body` part of the `task` document): `uri` is the item. Its state, fields, About, links, comments, activity and mounts stay oxplow's.

label: state control
about: A task's state control (the `state` part of the `task` document; its Move To is never replaced, so an item can always move): `uri` is the item. The item's own provider's extension replaces it, whichever is active: it shows that provider's own states.

label: history graph
about: The commit history's graph (`GitHistoryPage`, the Git dashboard): `head_sha` the stream's head, `reveal_sha` a commit to scroll to and mark (or null), `limit` how many commits. Its view is Git History's filters (`q`, `author`, `branch`; v2), which core's own list reads too. Core's own is a plain list; the graph is oxplow-bundled's component.

label: effort verdict
about: An effort's verdict, the first line of its review page (`DiffViewPage`): `effort_id` is the effort's row id. Core has no verdict of its own: what counts as tested, covered or backed is a review policy's, so with no replacement (or `oxplow` chosen) the page shows none. oxplow-bundled's is the default.
